summary: Grafik Pracy backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth (admin seed login, employee register, /me, wrong password 401, duplicate 409), users RBAC (401 no token, 403 employee, 200 admin), user CRUD + persistence + soft-delete + self-delete guard, meta, schedule GET/PUT/generate/clear-shift with role checks, summary math (10h -> 300, 12 shifts/week = 3600), settings public GET / admin PUT, chat auth + post/get with mine flag. Frontend (mobile 390x844): admin login works; all 5 tabs render (Teraz/Grafik/Zarobki/Czat/Ustawienia); Grafik week nav + generate modal (gen-confirm) + shift edit (assign-P) all wire to backend and show toast; Czat send message succeeds and appears; Ustawienia admin panel add-user via uf-* form succeeds with 'Dodano użytkownika' toast and appears in list; guest mode correctly hides Czat tab and shows 'Tryb podglądu' banner on home. Person keys P/M/L merged with users having personKey render shift names correctly (e.g. shift shows 'TEST CRUD' when user has personKey=P).

issues: Non-blocking console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (react-native-web) - minor, likely from a dependency (e.g. Pressable ripple). Consider suppressing or upgrading the offending component.

action_items: Optional: Silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' web warning by migrating callers to style.pointerEvents (or updating the RN-web component using it). Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_user allows overwriting an existing displayName with empty string via 'body.displayName or target.get(\'displayName\')' - OK, that preserves prior name when empty. Good.
server.py update_user does not check for email uniqueness on change - could create duplicate emails if admin edits to an existing address. Minor: consider a pre-check.
generate/save/clear-shift use datetime string in weeks.updatedAt but get_week returns whatever is stored, consistent. OK.
personKey uniqueness across users is not enforced - two users could share personKey P, causing displayName merge to pick the last one. Consider unique constraint or admin UX warning.
File sizes are within limits; server.py 549 lines OK.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed with 'test_' created during backend tests and one 'TEST UF User' via frontend add-user flow. Admin is seeded by backend on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_grafik_api.py - it self-generates unique week offsets so it is idempotent across runs. BASE_URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env or falls back to /app/frontend/.env. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive and stable - use them directly for any UI regression.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Two initial pytest failures were test-side case-sensitivity (server correctly lowercases emails) and week-collision from prior runs; both fixed in the test file.
